# Partition replay and publishing

A data consumer needs a safe daily partition replacement. Deduplicate replayed rows, quarantine wrong-partition input and retain the last good partition on failure.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
{
  "published": [
    {
      "id": "B1",
      "partition": "2026-05-15",
      "channel": "web"
    },
    {
      "id": "B2",
      "partition": "2026-05-15",
      "channel": "community"
    }
  ],
  "blocked": false,
  "quarantine": []
}
```

## Failure prevented
Appending a replay duplicates a record instead of replacing the partition.
